evals.prompt: Run QA gates for a project with package.json, pnpm-lock.yaml, and scripts lint, build, test, and test:ui.
evals.expected_output: Detects pnpm, builds a gate plan, runs lint, build, unit, affected if available, and conditional UI gates, then writes qa-report.md.

assertions.name: detects-pnpm
assertions.description: The response chooses pnpm from pnpm-lock.yaml.

assertions.name: writes-report
assertions.description: The response writes a structured QA gate report.

evals.prompt: Run QA gates in a repo that has package.json and Cargo.toml.
evals.expected_output: Selects the first matching runner according to the documented detection order unless a quality-gates guide overrides it, and reports skipped gates for unavailable scripts.

assertions.name: deterministic-runner-selection
assertions.description: The response follows documented runner precedence.

assertions.name: skips-missing-scripts
assertions.description: The response marks missing Node scripts as skipped rather than failed.

evals.prompt: Run QA gates in a repo with no package.json, Cargo.toml, pyproject.toml, go.mod, or quality-gates guide.
evals.expected_output: Reports unknown runner and asks once for lint, build, and test commands or permission to skip.

assertions.name: unknown-runner
assertions.description: The response does not assume npm when no manifest exists.

assertions.name: asks-for-commands
assertions.description: The response asks the user for quality gate commands.
